mutations.name: target identity falls back to raw URL equality
mutations.comment: Equivalent paths, symlinks, hard links, credentials, ports, and loopback aliases must not bypass the destructive-reset guard.

mutations.name: desired-state identity falls back to raw URL equality
mutations.comment: A database-URL desired state is just as destructive to reset through an alias as the target is.

mutations.name: target identity comparison errors fail open
mutations.comment: Malformed or unsupported target URLs must stop the operation before the dev database is reset.

mutations.name: desired-state identity comparison errors fail open
mutations.comment: Malformed or unsupported desired-state URLs must stop the operation before the dev database is reset.
